name: Annul Touch
description: Annul a small hostile soul stir with a precise touch of its opposite before it can grow.

name: Negation Glimpse
description: Glimpse the point where a hostile soul technique can be negated and mark it for the next beat.

name: Revoking Guard
description: Revoke each hostile soul push as it arrives so the guard never fills with force.

name: Annulled Ache
description: Annul the ache a hostile soul blow left in an ally until the soul rests easy again.

name: Negate Surge
description: Negate a rising surge of hostile soul force by matching its climb with an equal fall.

name: Revoke Touch
description: Revoke the hold of a soul curse on an ally with a touch of its exact opposite.

name: Stifling Calm
description: Spread a stifling calm over foes so that their soul techniques cannot gather their usual force.

name: Total Negation
description: Negate every hostile soul note within the reach of the user so that the field around them runs still.

name: Reversal Mirror
description: Turn a hostile soul note exactly upside down and send it back so that it rebounds on its caster.

name: Lattice Reading
description: Read the lattice of a hostile soul technique to find which strand carries its weight.

name: Strand Sever
description: Cut the weight-bearing strand of a hostile soul technique so that it sags apart.

name: Lattice Guard
description: Hold the soul in a lattice of its own that spreads a hostile push across many strands.

name: Strand Knitting
description: Knit again the soul strands an ally lost when a hostile technique broke their weave.

name: Lattice Collapse
description: Collapse the lattice of a hostile soul technique inward so that it cancels upon itself.

name: Strand Release
description: Release the strands of a hostile weave from an ally one at a time until the soul is free.

name: Structural Null
description: Cancel a heavy soul technique by finding and countering each of its strands in turn until none remains.

name: Held Lattice
description: Seize the lattice of a foe's running soul technique and hold it frozen until the foe lets it go.

name: Twin Opposite
description: Pair a hostile soul note with its twin opposite so that the two meet and vanish.

name: Mirror Glance
description: Read the mirror image of a hostile soul technique to know the exact shape of its answer.

name: Mirrored Guard
description: Hold up a mirrored guard of stillness that dulls whatever hostile force looks into it.

name: Paired Easing
description: Ease the strained soul of a partner by pairing each of its jolts with a soothing answer.

name: Hawk Silence
description: Fall silent like a hawk and drop that silence on a foe's soul technique at its start.

name: Mirrored Wave
description: Send out a mirrored wave that meets a hostile soul wave crest for crest and cancels it.

name: Opposite Release
description: Release a partner from a soul affliction by laying its exact opposite over it.

name: Dual Cancel
description: Cancel two hostile soul notes at once on twin tracks so that neither reaches its mark.

name: Twin Reversal
description: Reverse a hostile soul strike in two mirrored turns and send it back at double its own weight.

name: Perfect Mirror
description: Hold a perfect mirror of opposites round the user until no hostile soul force can find a way in.

name: Hovering Calm
description: Hover in a high still calm so that hostile soul force passes beneath and finds no mark.

name: Sky Glint
description: Catch the glint of a hostile soul technique far off and mark where it will fall.

name: Feathered Null
description: Brush a hostile soul note with a feather of stillness and leave it without sound.

name: Quiet Perch
description: Bring an ally's shaken soul down to rest as gently as a hawk settles on a perch.

name: Stooping Quiet
description: Drop a stoop of stillness onto a hostile soul technique from above and cancel it at once.

name: Hawk Unbinding
description: Cut a soul binding from an ally with the swift cancelling stroke of a hawk's talon.

name: Quiet Cry
description: Utter a cry that carries no sound and silences the soul technique of a foe.

name: Azure Stillness
description: Spread a clear and perfect stillness over the user until hostile soul force dies in it.

name: Silent Stoop
description: Stoop on a foe's soul in total silence and press out the force of its next technique.

name: Sworn Quiet
description: Hold to the sworn quiet and let a hostile soul note fade against it unanswered.

name: Calm Bearing
description: Take the bearing of the stillest soul in a group and read the others by their distance from it.

name: Vane Turn
description: Turn the soul like a vane into a hostile force so that it slides past on either side.

name: Sworn Easing
description: Ease the soul of a comrade with the sworn word of quiet until its trembling stops.

name: Oath Quench
description: Quench a spreading hostile soul force by holding the oath of quiet against it.

name: Vow Unbinding
description: Speak the vow that unbinds a comrade from a hostile hold upon the soul.

name: Unwalled Stillness
description: Stand in the open with no cover and let a perfect stillness cancel all hostile soul force.

name: Held Oath
description: Hold the oath of quiet over foes until their soul techniques will not rise.

name: Quiet Bearing
description: Take the bearing of a hostile soul note and cancel it on the same line.

name: Drift Sounding
description: Read the drift of a hostile soul force to learn where it is turning next.

name: Even Heading
description: Hold the soul on a level heading so that a hostile push cannot turn it from its course.

name: Wind Settling
description: Settle the soul of an ally as a wind drops at dusk until the unrest in it subsides.

name: Heading Break
description: Break the course of a foe's soul technique at its turn so that it spends itself wide.

name: Bearing Quench
description: Quench a hostile soul force by holding a bearing against its heading until it falls away.

name: Heading Release
description: Release an ally from a curse that has bent the heading of their soul and set it true.

name: Drift Press
description: Press a foe's soul technique into a slow drift until it loses its aim and its power.

name: Fixed Quiet
description: Fix a quiet over the user that no hostile soul force can turn or break through.

name: Unmoved Bearing
description: Stand on an unmoved bearing so that even the heaviest soul blow glances off without a mark.
